viator_experiences.title: Old Town Small-Group Edinburgh Beer Walking and Tasting Tour
viator_experiences.summary: Edinburgh boasts a unique brewing heritage that is often overshadowed by Scotland's celebrated whiskies. This small-group walking tour shines a spotlight…
viator_experiences.description_md: Edinburgh boasts a unique brewing heritage that is often overshadowed by Scotland's celebrated whiskies. This small-group walking tour shines a spotlight on the capital's now-resurgent beer scene, taking in several of the city's top pubs and beer bars. As you stroll the Royal Mile and explore Old Town highlights, your local guide explains how Edinburgh was once the world's leading exporter of bottled beer. Along the way you enjoy six beer tastings plus a half-pint of cask ale, learning the stories behind each brew as you go.

viator_experiences.title: Edinburgh Brewery Tour
viator_experiences.summary: This two-hour experience takes you behind the scenes at the Edinburgh Beer Factory, one of the city's most esteemed breweries. Your guide doubles as a…
viator_experiences.description_md: This two-hour experience takes you behind the scenes at the Edinburgh Beer Factory, one of the city's most esteemed breweries. Your guide doubles as a professional brewer, explaining how the beer is crafted as you tour the working brewery. Along the way you taste unfiltered beer drawn straight from the tanks and enjoy two glasses of the brewery's well-regarded Paolozzi lager, accompanied by snacks. You will also hear the story of Scottish Pop Art pioneer Eduardo Paolozzi, who inspired the brewery. The small-group tour is delivered in English and includes a voucher for the gift shop.

viator_experiences.title: Edinburgh Food Tour with Scotch, Haggis, a Secret Dish and More
viator_experiences.summary: On this three-hour small-group walking tour you explore Edinburgh's UNESCO-listed Old and New Towns in the company of a local guide. Along the route you…
viator_experiences.description_md: On this three-hour small-group walking tour you explore Edinburgh's UNESCO-listed Old and New Towns in the company of a local guide. Along the route you sample Scottish classics including authentic haggis with neeps and tatties, award-winning Lowland single malt whisky, Scottish cakes, local fudge and a traditional dessert, plus the company's Secret Dish. The guide shares why Edinburgh locals are so passionate about their food while leading you through the city's foodie hotspots. Groups are capped at ten participants, and the experience is offered in English with hotel pick-up and drop-off included.

viator_experiences.title: A Wee Taste of Edinburgh Walking Food and Drink Tour
viator_experiences.summary: A Wee Taste of Edinburgh is a five-hour walking food and drink tour led by a local host. It takes you to small, independent spots away from the usual…
viator_experiences.description_md: A Wee Taste of Edinburgh is a five-hour walking food and drink tour led by a local host. It takes you to small, independent spots away from the usual tourist trail, where you enjoy curated tastings and drinks while learning about the city's food scene. The tour departs from Barclay Viewforth Church near the Meadows and returns to the same meeting point, with a maximum of twelve travellers per group. It is offered in English and two additional languages, and guests frequently praise their knowledgeable guides.

viator_experiences.title: Edinburgh: Holyrood Distillery Whisky and Gin Tour Tasting
viator_experiences.summary: This approximately one-hour guided tour explores Holyrood Distillery in the heart of Edinburgh, where both whisky and gin are produced. A knowledgeable…
viator_experiences.description_md: This approximately one-hour guided tour explores Holyrood Distillery in the heart of Edinburgh, where both whisky and gin are produced. A knowledgeable host leads you through the working distillery and explains the production process behind each spirit. The visit concludes with a tasting of the distillery's whisky and gin. Offered in English with mobile tickets, the experience is recommended by 95 per cent of travellers and holds a Badge of Excellence.

viator_experiences.title: Edinburgh: Gin Distillery Tasting & Tour at South Loch Gin
viator_experiences.summary: This 90-minute experience takes you to 56 North, a working distillery and gin bar in central Edinburgh and one of Scotland's oldest gin bars. Your host…
viator_experiences.description_md: This 90-minute experience takes you to 56 North, a working distillery and gin bar in central Edinburgh and one of Scotland's oldest gin bars. Your host talks you through the detailed process of how gin is made, turning the tasting into an educational session. Along the way you enjoy a welcome gin and tonic, a gin cocktail and three South Loch gin samples served with premium mixers. All alcoholic drinks are included and the small-group visit is recommended by 99 per cent of travellers.
